content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "This is the real reason, not just a career pivot. Watching that up close, year after year, probably sharpened something an MBA case study never could.

Ten years making other companies efficient is actually a serious asset here. You know where the waste hides, you know how to build margin back into a broken chain. That's not nothing against a problem like this.

Where in the chain are you thinking about starting, the farmer side or somewhere downstream?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
